mapper.select: SELECT r.* FROM merchant_npc_knowledge_head h JOIN merchant_npc_knowledge_revision r ON r.id=h.revision_id AND r.merchant_id=h.merchant_id AND r.owner_member_id=h.owner_member_id AND r.version=h.version WHERE h.merchant_id=#{merchantId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM merchant_npc_knowledge_revision WHERE merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND owner_member_id=#{ownerId} AND version=#{version} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM merchant_npc_knowledge_revision WHERE merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND owner_member_id=#{ownerId} AND request_id=#{requestId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO merchant_npc_knowledge_revision (merchant_id,owner_member_id,version,request_id,content_json,content_hash) SELECT id,member_id,#{version},#{requestId},#{contentJson},#{contentHash} FROM mms_merchant WHERE id=#{merchantId} AND member_id=#{ownerMemberId} AND status=1 AND account_status=1 AND del_flag=0

INSERT INTO merchant_npc_knowledge_head(merchant_id,owner_member_id,version,revision_id) SELECT id,member_id,#{version},#{id} FROM mms_merchant WHERE id=#{merchantId} AND member_id=#{ownerMemberId} AND status=1 AND account_status=1 AND del_flag=0
